data.long_meaning: From the Persian word 'gohar' which means 'light, radiance'. This name is often given to girls in Iran and other Persian-speaking countries as a symbol of beauty and grace. The name Gohar carries the meaning “Light, Radiance” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Persian. Parents who choose Gohar usually hope their child will grow to embody light, radiance and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.etymology: Gohar belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Light, Radiance.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Gohar total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.
